      • createClockWithSimulation

        public AcceleratedAndSimulationClock createClockWithSimulation(java.lang.String clockURI,
                                                               long unixEpochStartTimeInNanos,
                                                               java.time.Instant startInstant,
                                                               double accelerationFactor,
                                                               fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.time.Time simulatedStartTime,
                                                               fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.time.Duration simulatedDuration)
                                                        throws java.lang.Exception
        Description copied from interface: ClocksServerWithSimulationCI
        create an accelerated and simulation clock with the given parameters associated with the given URI.

        Contract

         pre     clockURI != null && !clockURI.isEmpty()
 pre     unixEpochStartTimeInNanos > 0
 pre     startInstant != null
 pre     accelerationFactor > 0.0
 pre     simulatedStartTime != null
 pre     simulatedDuration != null && simulatedDuration.getSimulatedDuration() > 0.0
 pre     simulatedStartTime.getTimeUnit().equals(simulatedDuration.getTimeUnit())
 post    return != null
 post    return.getStartEpochNanos() == unixEpochStartTimeInNanos
 post    return.getStartInstant().equals(startInstant)
 post    return.getAccelerationFactor() == accelerationFactor
 post    getClock(clockURI).equals(return)
        Specified by:
        createClockWithSimulation in interface ClocksServerWithSimulationCI
        Parameters:
        clockURI - URI designating the created clock.
        unixEpochStartTimeInNanos - start time in Unix epoch time expressed in nanoseconds.
        startInstant - start instant to be aligned with the unixEpochStartTimeInNanos.
        accelerationFactor - acceleration factor to be applied between elapsed time as Instant and elapsed time as Unix epoch time in nanoseconds.
        simulatedStartTime - start time of the simulation, in simulated logical time.
        simulatedDuration - duration of the simulation, in simulated time.
        Returns:
        the newly created clock.
        Throws:
        java.lang.Exception - to do.
        See Also:
        ClocksServerWithSimulationCI.createClockWithSimulation(java.lang.String, long, java.time.Instant, double, fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.time.Time, fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.time.Duration)
